A font's bold and italic now belong to its family, so Arial in bold is drawn with Arial's bold file.

**Upgrade if you register fonts of your own**, system fonts above all: `Register`, `RegisterDirectory`, `--fonts`,
`--font`. The faces bundled in `Frisket.Fonts` name themselves in English only and are read exactly as before, so a
document drawn with them comes out as it did, to the byte. Nothing was removed or renamed, and the template format
has no new properties.

## Fixed: a font's bold or italic was a family of its own

A font sold worldwide gives its name in dozens of languages, one record each. Arial's bold says `Bold` in US
English, then `Negreta`, `Fett`, `Gras` and twenty more. The engine kept the last record it read. Records are
sorted by language, and Arial's last is French Canadian, so its bold became a family called `Arial Gras`. A
template asking for Arial in bold, in italic or in both was drawn in the regular, with no error.

Read with 0.6.0 and with 0.6.1, from the fonts of a Windows machine:

| File | 0.6.0 | 0.6.1 |
|---|---|---|
| `arialbd.ttf` | `Arial Gras`, bold | `Arial`, bold |
| `ariali.ttf` | `Arial Italique`, italic | `Arial`, italic |
| `timesbd.ttf` | `Times New Roman Gras`, bold | `Times New Roman`, bold |
| `segoeuib.ttf` | `Segoe UI Gras`, bold | `Segoe UI`, bold |
| `msgothic.ttc` | `ＭＳ ゴシック 標準` | `MS Gothic` |
| `malgun.ttf` | `맑은 고딕` | `Malgun Gothic` |
| `simsun.ttc` | `宋体 常规` | `SimSun` |

On that machine, the whole font directory made 152 families with 0.6.0 and makes 116 now. The language of the
machine does not matter: the same files are read the same way on Linux.

The name is now chosen in this order: English for Windows (US English first), then a Unicode record, then
Macintosh English, then any other language. A font named only in Japanese, say, keeps that name.

## Worth checking

- **A template that names a localized family no longer finds it.** If you wrote `Arial Gras` because a font list
  showed it, the render now throws `FontNotFoundException`, naming the families the library holds. Write `Arial`
  with `Bold = true`.
- **Documents set in system fonts can change.** Bold and italic text that was drawn in the regular is now drawn in
  its own cut, which is wider or narrower, so line breaks and the page count can move.
- **Font lists are shorter.** `frisket fonts`, the server's `/fonts` and `fk_fonts_list` show one family where
  they showed up to four.
- **A font that names its style in no English at all** still has that word added to its family name, because the
  style words the engine recognises are English. None of the fonts of the machine measured does this.
